record.paper_title: Effective non-linear dynamics of binary condensates and open problems
record.original_question: For the two-species Bose gas in the Gross-Pitaevskii scaling considered in this paper, can one remove the positivity assumption on the interaction potentials and still rigorously derive persistence of two-component condensation together with the effective coupled Gross-Pitaevskii system? Equivalently, can the theorem proved here under positive, spherically symmetric, compactly supported interaction potentials be extended to allow non-positive interactions at the true Gross-Pitaevskii scaling, rather than only in softer scaling regimes?

evidence.quote: Conversely, the removal of the positivity condition is an important open problem in the subject; in [19], it is proven positivity can be removed for a much softer scaling than the one in (21).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider a three-dimensional dilute gas of $N=N_1+N_2$ identical bosons of two species, evolving under the many-body Hamiltonian
$$H_N = \sum_{j=1}^{N_1}\bigl(-\Delta_{x_j}+U_1(x_j)\bigr) + \sum_{j=1}^{N_2}\bigl(-\Delta_{y_j}+U_2(y_j)\bigr) + \sum_{i<j}^{N_1} N^2 V_{11}(N(x_i-x_j)) + \sum_{i<j}^{N_2} N^2 V_{22}(N(y_i-y_j)) + \sum_{i=1}^{N_1}\sum_{j=1}^{N_2} N^2 V_{12}(N(x_i-y_j)),$$
acting on the bosonic Hilbert space $L^2_{\mathrm{sym}}(\mathbb{R}^{3N_1})\otimes L^2_{\mathrm{sym}}(\mathbb{R}^{3N_2})$, with $N_1/N\to c_1\in(0,1)$ and $N_2/N\to c_2=1-c_1$ as $N\to\infty$. The pair interactions $V_{ab}:\mathbb{R}^3\to\mathbb{R}$ ($a,b\in\{1,2\}$) are assumed spherically symmetric and compactly supported, and $U_1,U_2$ are external trapping potentials.

Suppose that at time $t=0$ the state of the system exhibits complete two-component Bose-Einstein condensation onto one-particle orbitals $\varphi_1^0,\varphi_2^0\in H^1(\mathbb{R}^3)$, in the sense that the reduced one-body density matrices of each species converge to $|\varphi_a^0\rangle\langle\varphi_a^0|$.

Question: Without imposing the pointwise positivity condition $V_{ab}\geq 0$ (i.e., allowing partially attractive interactions), can one rigorously prove that the property of two-component condensation is propagated by the Schrödinger evolution generated by $H_N$, with the time-evolved condensate orbitals $\varphi_1(t),\varphi_2(t)$ satisfying the coupled Gross-Pitaevskii system
$$i\partial_t\varphi_1 = -\Delta\varphi_1 + U_1\varphi_1 + 8\pi a_{11} c_1|\varphi_1|^2\varphi_1 + 8\pi a_{12} c_2|\varphi_2|^2\varphi_1,$$
$$i\partial_t\varphi_2 = -\Delta\varphi_2 + U_2\varphi_2 + 8\pi a_{22} c_2|\varphi_2|^2\varphi_2 + 8\pi a_{12} c_1|\varphi_1|^2\varphi_2,$$
where $a_{ab}$ denotes the s-wave scattering length of $V_{ab}$? Equivalently, can the rigorous derivation, which is known under the positivity assumption $V_{ab}\geq 0$ at the true Gross-Pitaevskii scaling and known without positivity only under softer scalings $N^{3\beta-1}V(N^\beta\cdot)$ with $\beta<1$, be extended so as to remove the positivity assumption while keeping $\beta=1$?
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is explicitly identified as an open problem in the relevant literature on binary condensates in the Gross-Pitaevskii scaling. Rigorous derivations of the coupled GP system are available either under positivity of all interaction potentials at the true GP scaling (Michelangeli-Olgiati, 2017), or without positivity but only under softer (NLS-type) scalings. A search did not surface a result removing the positivity assumption at the genuine GP scaling for two-component condensates, so the problem appears to remain open as of 2026.

status_evidence.title: Effective Non-linear Dynamics of Binary Condensates and Open Problems
status_evidence.snippet: Discussion of binary condensate derivation and open problems including removal of positivity at the GP scaling.
status_evidence.claim: The removal of the positivity condition at the Gross-Pitaevskii scaling is listed as an open problem; positivity has been removed only at softer scalings.

status_evidence.title: Gross-Pitaevskii non-linear dynamics for pseudo-spinor condensates
status_evidence.snippet: Derives the coupled GP system for pseudo-spinor BEC under short-scale repulsive interaction in the Gross-Pitaevskii scaling.
status_evidence.claim: Rigorous derivation of coupled GP for binary BEC is established under the assumption of positive (repulsive) interaction potentials.
